project_name: Northern Data Stanton County flagship data center
aliases: Northern Data US Inc Stanton County project
status_detail: County approved Future Land Use Map/zoning change from Transitional Agricultural to Light Industrial on Dec. 6, 2021 for Northern Data; later reporting says Northern Data paused the project and sold the 40-acre site without breaking ground.
notes: Official minutes identify Walter & Ronda Kennedy/Northern Data US Inc zoning request for property in NE SE 36-24-1 and say Northern Data presented the project; local news described a 110,000-120,000 sf facility on 40 acres about five miles outside Stanton and up to $20M investment. Flatwater later reported Northern Data wanted 70 MW, paused six months after buying land, then sold the plot before construction.

project_name: Jigowatt Stanton County crypto mining/data center
aliases: Kenosha Creek Preserve LLC data center
status_detail: Operational crypto-mining/data load facility on the former Northern Data property; company has sought an expansion from about 20 MW to 70 MW, with related transmission upgrades discussed by NPPD.
notes: Official April 17, 2023 minutes say Kenosha Creek Preserve LLC of Lincoln purchased the Northern Data property with intent to construct a data center and discussed electrical requirements and road upgrades. Flatwater identifies the operating company as Lincoln-based Jigowatt, describes 10 containers of crypto mining computers, current load of 20 MW, and a request to increase to 70 MW. KTIV also reports the site is a bitcoin mine owned by Jigowatt and located near Stanton.
